title: ajax minor
intro: Ajax minor, commonly known as Tribulus terrestris, is a small, flowering plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include improving cardiovascular health, reducing inflammation, and enhancing male fertility. The therapeutic actions of Tribulus terrestris are attributed to its ability to act as a natural diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, as well as its potential to improve blood sugar levels and blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Tribulus terrestris include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
